name: Data.Pair.smul_apply_xiSum
summary: Apply L termwise and recognise ⟨Ξ, Ξ⟩ through inner_trivialLift.

steps.claim: The conjugate of inner_trivialLift at g: the inner product of the trivial lift with its kernel forms.
steps.lean: have t := congr(star $(inner_trivialLift _ g (lValueData H.2 ϑ).trivialLift))

steps.claim: Rewrite it through the theta descent of the kernel form and the twisted central operator (theta_eq_inner_kernelForm, twistedCentralOp_kernelForm).
steps.lean:
simp [theta_eq_inner_kernelForm, mul_comm' _ g, ← twistedCentralOp_kernelForm,
    ← inner_twistedCentralOp, twistedCentralOp_trivialLift] at t

steps.claim: Expand xiSum, intAlgPart and the inner products as class sums, apply e termwise, and compare (ring).
steps.lean:
simp [inner, LevelForm.innerAt_eq_stdClassSum, xiSum, intAlgPart, trivialLift, norm_smul, mul_pow,
    t, ← Complex.mul_conj', apply_eq_evalForm,
    map_classSum, ↓classSum_mul, mul_classSum, division_def, H.1, gramForm_apply, mul_sum, sum_mul,
    dot_mulVec_eq_sum_sum, -norm_pow]; congr! 6; rw [e]; ring!
